<h2 class="newsBoxPostTitle"><a class="entry-categories" href="https://taxguru.in/company-law/independent-directors-proficiency-selection-companies-act-2013.html" title="Independent Directors – Proficiency &amp; Selection under Companies Act, 2013"><i class="fa fa-angle-double-right"></i> Independent Directors – Proficiency &amp; Selection under Companies Act, 2013</a></h2>
<div class="margint-10"></div>
<div class="pull-left padding5 hidden-xs hidden-sm"></div> <p align="justify"><span class="small"><a href="https://taxguru.in/category/company-law/" rel="category tag">Company Law</a></span> - The Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) has, vide notification dated 22nd October, 2019, notified the Companies (Appointment and Qualification of Directors) Fifth Amendment Rules, 2019 which shall substitute Rule 6 of the Companies (Appointment and Qualification of Directors) Rules, 2014. The amendment rules shall come into force w.e.f. 1...</p>
<a class="btn btn-primary btn-xs marginb-10" href="https://taxguru.in/company-law/independent-directors-proficiency-selection-companies-act-2013.html" title="Independent Directors – Proficiency &amp; Selection under Companies Act, 2013">Read More</a>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="row margint-20">
<div class="col-md-12 col-sm-12">
